A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 17-page paper, including Appendices A and B. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison support reliable comparison of the text, equations, figures, and table.

before.justification: Section 4 and Figures 3–5 report original Gemma 3 experiments comparing contextual and patched-model outputs on text and image prompts, measuring logit differences, total variation distance, and token matching.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original Gemma 3 experiments and their measured outcomes in Section 4 and Figures 3–5.

M1.justification: The per-token parameter updates, multi-layer procedure in Algorithm 1, and numerically stable variant in Appendix B are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same Mars weather-forecast generation and image-description scenarios. No datasets, tasks, or represented domains are added or removed.

E2.justification: The original model with full context remains the baseline for the patched model without context. The same direct and numerically stable update variants participate in the comparisons.

E3.justification: Section 4 retains the same model sizes, precision/platform settings, metrics, and procedure for keeping generation histories identical by following the baseline token after a mismatch.

E4.justification: The analyses comparing direct versus numerically stable updates and float32 versus bfloat16 behavior are unchanged. No ablations, robustness tests, or case studies are added or removed.

E5.justification: Figure 4 retains identical distribution and token-match summaries. There are no changes to repeated-run, seed, or uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Section 4.2 and Figures 3–5 report identical logit differences, total variation distances, token-match rates, and generated sequences. No result entries or findings change.

T1.justification: The equivalence theorems, controllability definitions, Appendix A lemmas and proofs, and Appendix B RMSNorm-inversion derivation are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about context–parameter equivalence, multi-layer extension, architectural generality, and empirical validation.

C2.justification: Both retain the explanation of numerical instability and the limitation that patches require recomputation per token and do not immediately provide a reusable global context update.

D1.justification: Hardware and precision disclosures, experimental instructions, and Appendix B implementation details are unchanged. No code or data access information changes.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, cited works, and research positioning are identical. The added acknowledgment does not introduce a citation or change the relationship to prior research.

P1.justification: v2 adds Mor Geva to the Section 7 acknowledgments and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. All other wording and section structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–5, Table 1, their captions, and the overall page layout are unchanged. Rendered differences are confined to the acknowledgment text and arXiv stamp.

improvement.justification: The only edits add Mor Geva to the acknowledgments and update the arXiv stamp. Scientific content, evidence, explanations, and presentation—including both appendices—remain unchanged, establishing no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
